My order arrived and one item is damaged, what do I do?
I’m really sorry the package didn’t arrive in the condition you expected. Let’s get a few details so our team can review this for you.
Please reply with everything below in one message:
Your full name
Your email address (the one used on the order, if possible)
Your order number (or, if you don’t have it handy, please share your email + phone number or shipping address so we can find the order)
The name of the item that is affected
Photos, if you can:
A clear photo of the affected plant/item
A photo of the product label (if there is one)
A photo of the box and any visible packaging issues
